key: CAIN: I saw him too!
en: CAIN: I saw him too!
ja: カイン: オレもあいつを見た!

key: RADOMUS: It would seem our culprit has been cornered.
en: RADOMUS: It would seem our culprit has been cornered.
ja: ラドマス: どうやら、犯人は追い詰められたようだね。

key: CAIN: Wait, where did he go?
en: CAIN: Wait, where did he go?
ja: カイン: 待て、どこに行った?

key: Did he use an Escape Rope?
en: Did he use an Escape Rope?
ja: あなぬけのヒモでも使ったのか?

key: RADOMUS: Now who's being silly?
en: RADOMUS: Now who's being silly?
ja: ラドマス: おや、馬鹿げたことを言っているのはどちらかね?

key: Press forward.
en: Press forward.
ja: 前へ進みなさい。

key: I believe there is just enough space beyond that gear.
en: I believe there is just enough space beyond that gear.
ja: あの歯車の向こうに、ちょうど通れるだけの隙間があるはずだ。

key: CAIN: Easy~
en: CAIN: Easy~
ja: カイン: 楽勝~

key: RADOMUS: This may be more challenging for an adult.
en: RADOMUS: This may be more challenging for an adult.
ja: ラドマス: これは、大人にとってはもう少し難しいかもしれないな。

key: RADOMUS: Hrm...
en: RADOMUS: Hrm...
ja: ラドマス: ふむ……

key: CAIN: Are you really stuck?
en: CAIN: Are you really stuck?
ja: カイン: マジで詰まってんのか?

key: Come to think of it, why doesn't this thing turn anyways?
en: Come to think of it, why doesn't this thing turn anyways?
ja: てか、これ、そもそもなんで回らないんだ?

key: RADOMUS: It froze when the Grand Gates did.
en: RADOMUS: It froze when the Grand Gates did.
ja: ラドマス: 大いなる門が止まった時に、これも止まったのだ。

key: It was around the time of Reborn City's collapse, nearly a decade ago.
en: It was around the time of Reborn City's collapse, nearly a decade ago.
ja: リボーンシティが崩壊した頃、もう十年近く前のことだ。

key: Presumably these mechanisms are linked to the doors themselves.
en: Presumably these mechanisms are linked to the doors themselves.
ja: おそらく、この機構は扉そのものと連動しているのだろう。

key: Many have tried to get them to operate again, but to no avail.
en: Many have tried to get them to operate again, but to no avail.
ja: 多くの者が再び動かそうと試みたが、誰もうまくいかなかった。

key: CAIN: Well, whatever.
en: CAIN: Well, whatever.
ja: カイン: まあ、いいや。

key: Even if it's tight, just force your way in~
en: Even if it's tight, just force your way in~
ja: きついなら、無理やり押し込めばいいだろ~

key: ...I mean, I don't normally say that to boys, but this is different.
en: ...I mean, I don't normally say that to boys, but this is different.
ja: ……まあ、普通は男にそんなこと言わないけどな、これは別だし。

key: RADOMUS: I'm going to pretend that I didn't understand that remark.
en: RADOMUS: I'm going to pretend that I didn't understand that remark.
ja: ラドマス: 今の発言は、理解しなかったことにしよう。

key: All right, here we go...
en: All right, here we go...
ja: よし、行くぞ……

key: CAIN: A-aah!
en: CAIN: A-aah!
ja: カイン: う、うわあっ!

key: RADOMUS: ...Well, now I've done it.
en: RADOMUS: ...Well, now I've done it.
ja: ラドマス: ……まあ、やってしまったな。

key: RADOMUS: Actually, it would appear that the drop isn't too far.
en: RADOMUS: Actually, it would appear that the drop isn't too far.
ja: ラドマス: いや、どうやら、落下はそれほど遠くないようだ。

key: It seems to lead into some kind of cave.
en: It seems to lead into some kind of cave.
ja: 何かの洞窟につながっているようだね。

key: Are you prepared for some spelunking?
en: Are you prepared for some spelunking?
ja: 洞窟探検の準備はできているかね?

key: CAIN: Oh yeah, I bet you can slide through there.
en: CAIN: Oh yeah, I bet you can slide through there.
ja: カイン: ああ、そこなら滑り込めそうだな。

key: You're definitely small enough, \PN.
en: You're definitely small enough, \PN.
ja: \PN、お前なら間違いなく小さいから大丈夫だ。

key: Work that body!
en: Work that body!
ja: その体、フル活用しろよ!

key: RADOMUS: Down the rabbit hole we go.
en: RADOMUS: Down the rabbit hole we go.
ja: ラドマス: さあ、うさぎの穴へと降りていこう。
